strings.name: Greta Gerwig
strings.summary: Gerwig moved from acting and co-writing low-budget independent films to solo directing. Lady Bird and Little Women explore girlhood, family and artistic ambition; Barbie brought her into global commercial cinema. She earned multiple Oscar writing or directing nominations and chaired the 2024 Cannes jury. At the cutoff, her Narnia adaptation remained scheduled for 2027.
